name: @luizsantiago/agentic-harness
description: A seatbelt for AI coding agents. Agree on the goal, break it into small jobs, prove each one, then a fresh review — automatic checks stop fake “done”. Loads one step at a time to save context. Works in Cursor and Claude.

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:gates
scripts.test:node: node --test test/install.test.js test/test_feature_init.test.js test/test_config.test.js test/test_archive.test.js test/test_delta_merge.test.js test/test_presets.test.js test/test_brownfield.test.js

author: luizsantiago
